meta.title: Profity
meta.description: Smart Money market analysis, trading journal, and prop firm challenge tracking.

landing.headline:
Trading signals
that explain the why
landing.subheadline: Profity reads market structure — Order Blocks, Fair Value Gaps, BOS/CHoCH — and generates signals with exact levels and full reasoning.
landing.socialProof: Used by traders in Ivory Coast, Senegal, Cameroon, Ghana and Nigeria
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to trade with method
landing.featureSignalsDesc: Entry, stop-loss, up to 3 take-profits, risk-reward ratio. Smart Money reasoning is unlocked for Pro and Elite subscribers.
landing.featureJournalDesc: Record every trade with your notes, tags and P&L. Link trades to signals to measure real impact.
landing.featurePropFirmDesc: Static or trailing drawdown, daily loss, profit target — every limit is tracked in real time with alerts before you get eliminated.
landing.featureCalendarDesc: High-impact macro events with automatic news signals. Never get caught off-guard by NFP or a rate decision again.
landing.featureAlertsDesc: Set a level, pick a direction. You get notified once when price hits — no spam on oscillations.
landing.featureMultiCurrencyDesc: XOF, XAF, GHS, NGN, USD, EUR — pay with CinetPay, Paystack or GeniusPay, in your currency.
landing.tiersSubtitle: Pick the plan that fits your practice
landing.faq1A: An analysis method that reads market structure the way institutions do: liquidity zones, order blocks, character changes (CHoCH) and breaks of structure (BOS). Profity automates this reading.
landing.faq2A: Every signal publishes its verified win rate — outcomes are frozen once recorded and cannot be edited. You see real performance, not a showcase.
landing.faq3Q: How does the prop firm tracker work?
landing.faq3A: You enter your challenge rules (FTMO, MyForexFunds, etc.) and Profity computes in real time the remaining margin before each limit — daily loss and drawdown — distinguishing static from trailing.
landing.faq4Q: What payment methods do you accept?
landing.faq4A: Mobile Money (Orange Money, MTN, Wave) via CinetPay, bank cards via Paystack, and wire transfer. XOF, XAF, GHS, NGN, USD and EUR are supported.
landing.footer: © {year} Profity. Smart Money analysis for African traders.
